kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 14.2% in 2025, up 40 basis points from 13.8% in 2024, reflecting a structural improvement of 370 basis points since 2022 (10.7%). This improvement results from pricing discipline, an SG&A efficiency program delivering EUR 200 million in gross cost reductions, and an industrial excellence program including six site closures.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Revenue stands at EUR 10.158 billion in 2025, down 5.2% from EUR 10.711 billion in 2024, reflecting soft market conditions and geopolitical challenges. The decline is mitigated by maintained pricing discipline and efficient cost management.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA — EBITDA excluding non-recurring or one-off items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA stands at EUR 1.444 billion in 2025, down 2.3% from EUR 1.478 billion in 2024, but up 24.8% since 2022 (EUR 1.157 billion), demonstrating the impact of structural margin improvement on value generation despite market headwinds.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating Income — profit from core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating income totals EUR 1.164 billion in 2025, reflecting solid operational performance generated by the execution of SG&A efficiency and industrial excellence programs, despite geopolitical challenges, tariffs and FX impacts.
kpis.signal: Robust operating profitability in a difficult market context

kpis.name: Employees (FTE)
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time equivalents employed by AkzoNobel in 2025.
kpis.description: AkzoNobel has 31,500 full-time equivalents in 2025, operating in more than 150 countries to support a world-class brand portfolio including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon.
kpis.signal: Global talent team covering more than 150 countries

kpis.name: Carbon Footprint Reduction (Scopes 1&2)
kpis.explanation: Percentage reduction in carbon footprint (scopes 1 and 2) versus the 2018 baseline.
kpis.description: AkzoNobel reduced its carbon footprint (scopes 1 and 2) by 47% versus the 2018 baseline, compared to 41% in 2024, demonstrating sustained progress in decarbonization. This progress reflects investments in renewable energy, including a EUR 50 million upgrade of the Waukegan aerospace plant and the adoption of wind and solar energy.

kpis.name: Return on Investment (ROI)
kpis.explanation: Return on investment measured as a percentage for 2025.
kpis.description: Return on investment reaches 13.5% in 2025, reflecting structural operational improvement and dynamic portfolio management, including the realization of the Akzo Nobel India Limited divestment at 25x EBITDA and continued positioning optimization in decorative paints in Southeast Asia.
kpis.signal: Capital efficiency reflecting operational improvement and portfolio management

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.description: Earnings per share stands at EUR 3.71 in 2025, reflecting solid operational performance and profitability improvement despite a challenging market environment.
kpis.signal: Shareholder value creation supported by profitability improvement

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability
